display_information.name: InternCRM
display_information.description: Your programme in Teams and Slack: notifications, bookings, check-ins.
display_information.long_description: InternCRM brings your programme into the conversation: meeting invites and reminders with a join link, interview decisions, survey check-ins answered with a click, session notes, and booking your next session. Every action runs as the person who linked their own account, with the same permissions as in the app.
